svg.title: Dimensional Operators — Primary Loci
svg.desc: Two aligned five-register matrices show all fifteen centropic dimensions and fifteen entropic inversions. Dots show single primary loci, solid lines show primary bands, and dashed lines show the expressly charted C10 and E10 bridge endpoints. Names follow the Field Physics glyph charts. Primary loci follow FP01 chapters 2 and 3.
svg.text: Primary loci along the hypostatic lattice
Primary locus ≠ exclusive operation. Faint alignment guides carry no additional activation claim.
C₁₃ ║: L₅ • E₁₃ ║⁻: IL₅ • membrane relations across registers remain distinct from these primary loci.
Names: Field Physics glyph registry and analytic framework • Loci: FP01 Chapters 2–3
